Method of Attack: Hijacks and bricks Dahua DVRs using CVE-2013-6117 vulnerability to take devices offline and prevent their addition to IoT botnets
Impacted Systems: Dahua DVRs running very old firmware vulnerable to CVE-2013-6117
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2013-6117 vulnerability via raw TCP connection on port 37777 with a special payload
